title: Reasoning Quality Matters: Combating Reasoning Collapse in LLM-based Embedding Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.20563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for producing context-rich text embeddings for retrieval. Most existing methods either treat embedding learning as passive feature extraction or exploit LLM reasoning through instruction following for better embedding optimization. However, specialization toward embedding objectives can suppress useful reasoning generation or produce retrieval-irrelevant text. We refer to these two forms of degradation as reasoning collapse. To address this issue, we propose CoFree (Collapse-Free Reasoning Embedding), a two-stage framework that progressively integrates LLM reasoning into query and document embedding optimization while preserving reasoning quality. translated_title: 推理质量至关重要：对抗基于大语言模型嵌入学习中的推理崩塌
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）近期在生成用于检索的上下文丰富的文本嵌入方面展现出强大潜力。现有方法要么将嵌入学习视为被动特征提取，要么通过指令遵循利用LLM推理来实现更好的嵌入优化。然而，向嵌入目标的专门化可能会抑制有用的推理生成，或产生与检索无关的文本。我们将这两种形式的性能退化称为推理崩塌。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CoFree（无崩塌推理嵌入），这是一个两阶段框架，在保持推理质量的同时，逐步将LLM推理整合到查询和文档的嵌入优化中。在第一阶段，CoFree采用参考引导的监督微调来恢复推理能力，并保留基础嵌入模型的表征强度。在第二阶段，我们引入双重奖励机制……
tldr: 本文提出CoFree两阶段框架，通过参考引导的监督微调和双重奖励机制，在将大语言模型推理能力融入嵌入优化的过程中有效防止推理崩塌，从而提升检索嵌入的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoFree, a two-stage framework that combines reference-guided supervised fine-tuning and dual rewards to integrate LLM reasoning into embedding optimization while combating reasoning collapse, thereby improving retrieval embedding quality.
